sentences.text: ----Respondents For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Deepak Bansal For Respondent(s) : Mr. Prem Singh Panwar, PP  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE MANOJ KUMAR GARG Order 10/10/2024 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned Public Prosecutor and also perused the material available on record.

The petitioner has been arrested in connection with FIR No.332/2022 of Police Station Mahila Thana, District Hanumangarh for offence under Sections 376(2)(n)(i)(k) & 506 of IPC and Sections 5(l)(n)/6 and 3/4(ii) of POCSO Act.
He has preferred this bail application under Section 483 BNSS (439 Cr.P.C.).
Counsel for the petitioner submits that earlier bail was granted to the petitioner by the learned trial Court but he jumped [2024:RJ-JD:41698] (2 of 2) [CRLMB-12793/2024] the bail on 27.06.2024.
Now the petitioner is in judicial custody since 18.09.2024.

Counsel further assures this Court that in future, the petitioner will remain present on each and every date before the trial court and if he Devanand vs State Of Rajasthan (2024:Rj-Jd:41698) on 10 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/86354563/
1 again jumps the bail then the indulgence of bail may not be extended to the petitioner
Learned Public Prosecutor has opposed the bail application.

Looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, I deem it just and proper to grant one more opportunity to the petitioner subject to the condition that he will appear before the tiral court on each and every date, failing which Public Prosecutor may file application for cancellation of bail.

Accordingly, the second bail application filed under Sec.483 BNSS (439 Cr.P.C.) is allowed and it is directed that petitioner Devanand S/o Shri Mohan Das shall be released on bail in connection with FIR No.332/2022 of Police Station Mahila Thana, District Hanumangarh provided he executes a personal bond in a sum of Rs.2,00,000/- with two sound and solvent sureties of Rs.1,00,000/- each to the satisfaction of learned trial court for his appearance before that court on each and every date of hearing and whenever called upon to do so till the completion of the trial.
